name: OpenSequence
description: Email sequences a person approves before they send: a researched first email, follow-ups in the same thread, and replies, bounces and booked meetings that stop the sequence. Best for outbound campaigns, cold email follow-ups and sales cadences, sent from a separate mailbox.

deploy.title: Deploy your email sequences
deploy.subtitle: Researched outreach that a person approves before anything is sent
